Some posts can only be downloaded while logged in. On a computer, log in to the site in your browser, export a cookies.txt file (Netscape format) with a cookies.txt export extension, copy it to this phone and import it here. Murem only uses it for on-device links. Anyone who has this file can use your account: export only the sites you need, never share it, and remove it here when you are done.
